title: Oathbringer
summary: The Everstorm ravages Roshar and the Fused—the ancient souls of the singers—return to reclaim their world. Dalinar Kholin must confront the darkest secrets of his past as he leads the newly gathered Knights Radiant to the mythical city of Urithiru, the ancient home of the Radiants hidden in the mountains. Kaladin struggles with the crushing weight of command and the loss of those he cannot save, while Shallan's multiple personalities fragment further as she investigates the secrets of the Unmade. As the coalition of monarchs fractures under pressure from the newly empowered Odium, Dalinar's history as the Blackthorn threatens to destroy everything he has built. The third ideal demands that a Radiant swear to seek the truth, even when it means facing the worst version of oneself.
archiveDescription: This record documents the relocation of the Radiant coalition to Urithiru, the ancient tower-city of the Knights Radiant hidden in the mountains of Roshar. The volume examines the deepening conflict with the Fused—the immortal souls of ancient singers—and the psychological toll of command on those who lead the defense. Central to this record is the examination of a highprince's past sins and the nature of redemption. The account provides substantial insight into the Unmade, the influence of Odium on Rosharan history, and the geography of the Cognitive Realm as it manifests around Roshar.
